mapper.select: SELECT s.score_id, s.stu_id, st.stu_name, s.course_name AS subject, s.score FROM score s LEFT JOIN student st ON s.stu_id = st.stu_id ORDER BY s.score_id DESC
SELECT s.score_id, s.stu_id, st.stu_name, s.course_name AS subject, s.score FROM score s LEFT JOIN student st ON s.stu_id = st.stu_id WHERE s.stu_id = #{stuId} ORDER BY s.score_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO score (stu_id, course_name, score) VALUES (#{stuId}, #{subject}, #{score})
